answer: A random beacon plus a compute pulse stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents at random; each picked agent must answer within minutes with a fresh pulse proving live work, bending like a willow. A missed pulse burns its 60-credit deposit. Faking 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits in deposits plus a live pulse each, every epoch; an honest agent pays 60 once and passes the velvet rope with work it already does.
